text:
sylvie: Opening a tiny PR to add a migration note + micro SDK snippets for json_schema structured output. will also fix two broken anchors and add a short streaming caveat. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1781
jared: nice. please include a one-paragraph migration checklist for teams moving from regex extraction to schema validation
mai: add a short note that python uses `structured_output` (snake_case) and JS uses `structuredOutput` (camelCase) so examples don't get mixed. also call out validation errors handling
sylvie: draft snippets below, kept minimal for the callout. will add a one-liner on fallback behavior (retry once, then fallback to text parser or surface errors)
```python
# python minimal: validate tool output
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
r = c.call_tool(name="parse_totals", input={"text":"..."}, structured_output={"type":"json_schema","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"total":{"type":"number"}},"required":["total"]}})
if getattr(r,'errors',None):
    # fallback
    fallback = fallback_text_parser(r.raw_text)
```
```js
// js minimal: camelCase style
import { RedClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedClient();
const res = await client.callTool({name:'parse_totals', input:{text:'...'}, structuredOutput:{type:'json_schema', schema:{type:'object', properties:{total:{type:'number'}}, required:['total']}}});
if (res.errors && res.errors.length) { /* fallback_text_parser(res.rawText) */ }
```
sylvie: streaming caveat: when stream=true partial JSON may be emitted and fail validation. recommend `stream=false` or `buffer_full_response=True` for critical enforcement. link runtime issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/432
jared: also update docs index anchors: replace `/docs/tooling/call` -> `/docs/tool-calling/` and `/docs/structured-output/#jsonschema` -> `/docs/structured-output/#json-schema` so old links stop 404ing
